# NVDA Controller Client 2026.3 (API 3.0), Windows x64

Copyright NV Access Limited and contributors. The unmodified shared library is licensed under LGPL 2.1; see LICENSE.txt and UPSTREAM_README.md. This program loads it dynamically; you may replace it with an ABI-compatible x64 controller client. NVDA itself must already be running. No NVDA installation or settings are changed.

Binary download: https://download.nvaccess.org/releases/2026.3/nvda_2026.3_controllerClient.zip

Download SHA256: e38a00689eab422f13aaed9aaaacdd3ae96411643b6f2f5fbf86222660ac7938

nvdaControllerClient.dll SHA256: 7ef3aaa056c8b3b37db9f8cd82da94ad6254f1726184f5fc17d8c90510f54908

The original DLL's Authenticode signature was verified as Valid on this development PC. No modifications have been made to the DLL.

Complete corresponding upstream source and build instructions are provided alongside this library in nvda-2026.3-source.tar.gz, downloaded from https://codeload.github.com/nvaccess/nvda/tar.gz/refs/tags/release-2026.3 (release commit 7eb1738dd1556775145453fdd8b6b7ca6b397693). Extract the archive and follow its developer/build instructions; the controller target is `scons source client`. Build tools and SDKs are separate prerequisites. The source is unmodified.
